translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

book.name: MAK
book.title: No Tahut na HinHinawas MAK ga Pakat Ie

content: Jisas ga hasur se ira haleng na sakana tanuo taar ta ira bore.
Io, Jisas ma ira uno bulu na harausur diet ga balos urau tiga palpal tano tamat na taah kom, tano hanuo audiet ira Gerasen.
Jisas ga suur laah tano mon. Kaik at mon tiga tunotuno nong ira sakana tanuo ga sasoha tana ga hansur mekaia ra matana haat na haratur. Ga hansur um gaam harsomane Jisas.

Iakano tunaan git kiskis ta ira matana haat na haratur ma taie tikai pai la taltale bia na wis kawasei. Sukmaal bia di git wiswis ie ma ra dadas na winwisaan ma ra dadas na hidihidi sakit, pa git harharuat.

Diet pa git taltale kanong no tunotuno git raprapat haitne ira dadas na hidihidi sakit ta ira limana ma git raprapat haitne mah ira dadas na winwisaan ta ira kakine. Taie tikai pa ga haruat bia na hamarur ie.
Ta ira kaba bung ma ira kaba kasakes bakut git kupkup haan karama ta ira matana haat na haratur ma aram mah ra uladih ma git kutkut hani um no tamaine ma ira haat.
Bia ga nes leh Jisas me tapaka ga hilau gaam singa bukunkek manalua tana.
Ga kakonga naliu sakit gaam tange, “Jisas Natine God nong i lua harsakit, waak u kis na gil iau! Nu sasalim uram hone God bia pa nu gil hangungut iau.”
Ga tange huo kanong Jisas gate tange tana, “Augu ra sakana tanuo, suur laah ta kanin ra tunotuno.”
Ma Jisas ga tiri ie, “Sige no hinsaam?” Ga balui hoken: “No hinsagu ‘Arip na arip.’ Warah? A haleng sakit mehet.”
Ma ga manga sasaring marmaris taar ta Jisas bia pa na tule se ira sakana tanuo mekaia ta iakano hanuo.
Io, ma a haleng na bore diet ga iaiaan tano gagena uladih hutet.
Ira sakana tanuo diet ga sasaring marmaris ta Jisas hoken: “Tule tar mehet ta kaiken ra bore waing mehet na sasoha ta diet.”

Ga haut se tar diet, io, ira sakana tanuo ga suur laah tano tunaan diet gaam sasoha balik ta ira bore. Diet ga hilau suur tano ula habo uram narako tano tamat na taah kom diet gaam konga. Ira bore bakut diet haruat ma airuo arip.
Io, ira ut na balaura bore diet ga hilau laah diet gaam hinawas kaia tano taman ma ta ira katon mah hutet. Io, ira matanaiabar diet ga haan laah wara nesnes ing Jisas gate gil tar.

Bia diet ga haan tupas Jisas diet ga nes no tunaan nong ira haleng na sakana tanuo ga sasoha taar baak tana ga kis taar kaia. Ira matanaiabar diet ga burut kanong ira kiniasine gate sigam tar ma no uno lilik mah gate palai.
Diet ing diet ga nes iakan diet ga hinawase ira matanaiabar tano mangana linge Jisas gate gil tar tano tunaan nong ira sakana tanuo ga sasoha taar baak tana. Ma diet ga hinawas mah ta ira bore.
Namur, ira matanaiabar diet ga ianga marmaris taar ta Jisas bia na haan laah tano udiet sibaan.
Tano pakana bung Jisas ga kaukawas uram narako tano mon no tunaan nong ira sakana tanuo baak ga sasoha taar tana ga duan Jisas bia dir na haan tika.

Jisas pa ga bale leh ie, iesen ga tange, “Nu haan tapukus tano num taman, taar ta ira hinsakaam ma nu hinawase diet a tamat na linge ie hohe no Watong i te gil tar taam. Io, nu hinawas mah tano uno harmarsai ukatiga ho ugu.”
Io, no tunaan ga haan taar tano hanuo Dekapolis. Ga haan gaam hinhinawase diet a tamat na linge ie hohe Jisas gate gil tar tana. Ma ing diet ga hadade diet ga manga karup.
Jisas ga halangalanga no hahin nong ga sam dadara ma no hinasik nong ga noh na minaat taar.
Io, Jisas ga balos ma tiga mon ures baling tiga palpal tano tamat na taah kom Galili. A tamat na matanaiabar ga haan luhut ie ing Jisas ga kis taar tano gagena no taah kom.

Tiga watong nong i harbalaurai taar tiga hala na lotu audiet ira Iudeia, no hinsana Iaros, ga haan ukaia. Bia ga nes leh Jisas ga puko taar menalua ta ira kakine ma ga ianga marmaris taar tana, “No nat na hahigu i te noh na minaat taar um. Mai, nu a bul ira limaam tana waing naga langalanga ma na lon.”
Io, Jisas ga sakatei. Ma a tamat na matanaiabar diet ga murmur hani ie ma diet ga hartaguniguni haan hutet tana.
Ma tiga hahin nalamin ta ira matanaiabar ga sam dadara. No uno minaset gate kisi ie haruat ma ra sangahul ma iruo na tinahon.
Gate kap ra but na tinirih ta ira haleng na ut na harulai ma gate hasurum bia tar ira uno kinewa ta diet. Pa ga langalanga tano minaset. No uno minaset balik ga kapkap haliarei.
Bia no hahin ga hadada nianga uta ira bilai na pakpakilai tane Jisas ga haan mon nalamin ta ira matanaiabar gaam haan ukaia namur tane Jisas gaam sigire no kiniasine.
Ga gil huo kanong ga lik hoken: “Bia ni sigire mon no kiniasine ni langalanga.”
Iakano pakana bung at mon no hinilau tano de ga takumut laah ma no hahin ga hamaan no tamaine bia gate langalanga sukun no uno minaset.
Ing at mon no hahin ga sigire no kiniasine, Jisas ga hamaan kilam bia ari ta ira uno dadas meram naliu gate haan talur ie. Ga tahurus gaam tiri diet, “Sige i sigire no kiniasigu?”
Ira uno bulu na harausur diet ga tange tana, “U biha? U nas ira matanaiabar diet hartaguniguni ma diet sumsubak ugu ma kana at baak u tirtiri bia sige i sigire ugu?”
Iesen Jisas at baak ga nanaas hurhurbit haan bia na nunure nong ga gil iakan ra linge.
No hahin ga burut gaam dedar kanong ga nunure kilam no bilai na linge ga hanuat taar tana. Io, ga singa bukunkek taar tane Jisas gaam hinawase ta ira tutun bakut.
Jisas ga tange tano hahin, “Natigu, no num nurnur i te halon ugu. Nu haan tatohun ma nu langalanga tano num minaset.”
Bia Jisas ga iangianga baak, ari tunaan diet ga hanuat meram tano hala tane Iaros ma diet ga hinawasei, “No nat na hahim i te maat. Wara bih um u nangnanget ma no tena harausur?”
Bia Jisas ga hadade kumaan tar ing diet ga tangtange ga tange tane Iaros, “Waak u burburut. Nu nurnur sen mon.”
Pa ga haut leh mah um tari bia diet na mur ie, ne Pita ma ne ningaar tasin Jemes ma ne Jon sen mon.
Bia diet ga hanuat taar tano ngasiane Iaros, Jisas ga hadade diet, diet ga susuah kupkup ma diet ga manga harharat.
Jisas ga haan laka ma ga tange ta diet, “Waak muat ra sunuah ma waak muat ra harat! No hinasik pai maat. I kubaba mon.”

Diet ga kurus balik ma diet ga kukutur tana. Namur bia gate tule hasur bakut se tar diet, ga lamus no pawasine no hinasik ma no ana sus mah. Ga lamus halaka mah ira aitul ing dal ga sakatei uram narako tano subaan di ga hainoh tar no hinasik kaia.
Ga palim no limana no hinasik ma ga tange tana, “Talita kaum,” kukuraina bia, “Hinasik, tut naliu!”
Kaik at mon no hinasik ga tut naliu ma ga haburen ginota (ma a sangahul ma iruo ira uno tinahon.) Ma diet kaia diet ga manga karup sakit.
Iesen Jisas ga tar ra dadas na nianga ta diet bia diet pa na hinawas ta iakano linge ga gil ie. Ga tange mah ta diet bia diet na tabar no hinasik ma ta nian.
